importance_detail.rationale: The Keep America Flying Act of 2026 provides mandatory continuing appropriations to ensure uninterrupted pay and benefits for air traffic controllers, essential FAA operational personnel, and TSA security screening employees during federal government shutdowns.

summary: The Keep America Flying Act of 2026 provides continuing funding to pay air traffic controllers, certain essential Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and Transportation Security Administration (TSA) employees, and related contractors during any period in fiscal year 2026 when regular government appropriations are not in effect.

affected_groups.effect: Receive standard rates of pay, allowances, pay differentials, and benefits during a government shutdown.
affected_groups.group: Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) air traffic controllers and essential operational personnel

affected_groups.effect: Receive standard rates of pay, allowances, pay differentials, and benefits during a government shutdown.
affected_groups.group: Transportation Security Administration (TSA) screening and security personnel

affected_groups.effect: Receive payments for providing support to the covered FAA and TSA personnel during a government shutdown.

key_provisions: Provides continuing appropriations for fiscal year 2026 to pay and provide benefits to air traffic controllers and other essential FAA operational personnel.
Provides continuing appropriations for TSA employees engaged in screening operations, aviation security duties, or related mission-support functions.
Appropriates funds for payments to FAA and TSA contractors who provide support to the covered personnel.
Sets the termination date for these funds as the earlier of regular appropriations being enacted or September 30, 2026.
Takes effect as if it had been enacted on September 30, 2025.
missing_information: Specific dollar amounts or total costs for the appropriations.
Details on how other federal agencies or non-essential personnel will be funded during a shutdown.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Keep America Flying Act of 2026 provides continuing funding to pay air traffic controllers, certain essential Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and Transportation Security Administration (TSA) employees, and related contractors during any period in fiscal year 2026 when regular government appropriations are not in effect.
summary_detail.significance: The bill ensures continuous federal funding for specific aviation safety and security personnel and their contractors during potential government shutdowns in fiscal year 2026.
